title.narrative: Enhancing women empowerment in Dushanbe, Varzob and Kulob

description.narrative: The objective of the action is to provide safe spaces and services, empower women economically, strengthen the response of local authorities, and foster the active engagement of civil society activists and communities. Ultimately, it seeks to contribute to the reduction of inequalities and the eradication of domestic violence and GBV and to promote human rights in Tajikistan
